details.description:
Start your day by taking care of your health with the goodness of Kellogg's Oats, which are quick to prepare and easy to consume. Oats are a wonder grain with more soluble fibre than some grains like wheat and rice. Kellogg's Oats are 100% whole grain and high in fibre and protein. Whole-grain oats provide energy to keep you going. They are low in sodium, and foods low in sodium may help reduce the risk of high blood pressure. Naturally cholesterol-free and with no added preservatives.
Kellogg's Oats can be used to prepare a variety of delicious recipes, including porridge, tempting dosas, tasty idlis, delectable upmas, savoury pohas, and many more, allowing you to make a smart start to a healthy lifestyle in a delicious way.
